criteria.name: C1_window_completeness_lifts_when_contamination_gated
criteria.non_degeneracy_basis: ARM_STOCK truncated in at least one cell, so there was a window collapse for the gate to explain.
criteria.note: Excludes ARM_HEALTH_DECOUPLED, where window_completeness is forced to ~1.0 by the manipulation and is a manipulation check rather than a measurement.

criteria.name: C2_event_rate_lifts_when_window_decoupled
criteria.note: Degenerate when no arm produced any consumption event: a rate comparison with no events discriminates nothing.

combination_rule: PASS iff the aggregate gate is non-degenerate (ANY arm green) AND at least one of C1 / C2 fires. C1 is additionally only READABLE when ARM_STOCK actually truncated (see its non_degenerate field); a non-reproducing stock arm routes to truncation_not_reproduced_c1_undiscriminating rather than to a null. C1 and C2 are NOT ANDed: they answer different halves of the question (did the window survive; did the rate move), and the autopsy's declared null is precisely C1-true / C2-false.

interpretation.label: window_restored_rate_unchanged
interpretation.note: The window is restored by gating contamination -- so the truncation WAS self-poisoning -- but the event rate per realised tick does not lift. This is the autopsy's declared H-energy null in its informative form: starvation only shortened the window, it did not suppress eating. The residual rate problem is not an energy problem.

preconditions.control: n_realised_ticks counted directly in the eval loop; the SAME statistic the load-bearing C1 window-completeness criterion routes on (a count of realised ticks), not a proxy for it.

evidence_direction_note: Governance 2026-08-21 gov-20260821-0203 ratified failure_autopsy_940-941-mech467-cluster_2026-08-20.json: V3-EXQ-940 (GOV-FANOUT-1 H-energy leg, environment axis) is a denominator diagnostic and does not exercise MECH-467's falsifier; it bears on the claim in neither direction. Its load-bearing C1 passed (window completeness lift 0.167037 vs 0.15) but at a 0.017 margin resting on 2 of 3 cells. Its C2 did NOT return a null: measured_ratio is null because the ratio divides by ARM_STOCK's event rate of exactly 0.0, so the criterion is arithmetically undefined, while its non-degeneracy guard (total_events_all_arms > 0) tests the pooled numerator rather than the denominator arm and therefore stamps it non_degenerate true. The emitted label window_restored_rate_unchanged and its note ('the residual rate problem is not an energy problem') are contradicted by the run's own per_arm_pooled: 0 events/2249 ticks (ARM_STOCK, rate 0.0), 2/2700 (ARM_CONTAM_OFF, 0.00074), 4/2700 (ARM_HEALTH_DECOUPLED, 0.00148) -- the rate rises monotonically with decoupling strength from exactly zero. On 4 events that is not significant either, so the honest state is unresolved. What the run DOES establish is decisive and should be preserved: a fully-realised 2700-tick window with contamination gated AND health clamped still produced only 4 events, so neither survival nor contamination explains the missing denominator, and 874b's arithmetic (8380-17200 ticks/arm needed against 2700 budgeted) is independently reconfirmed.
